name: adlc5
description: ADLC5 workflow skills and local kernel tools for Codex.

interface.longDescription:
ADLC5 helps developers deliver software changes through Specify → Plan → Tasks → Implement. Skills guide requirements discovery, architecture, task breakdown, implementation, verification, and PR review. A local deterministic kernel checks lifecycle gates and records evidence in the consumer repository. Repository Intelligence gathers project context; Pulse summarizes delivery state and recorded usage.

Requires local execution with Git, Bash, Python 3.10+, jq, and a supported coding-agent host. Run setup from your application repository. ADLC5 writes project scaffolding and local workflow records; review generated changes and command permissions before running delivery work. Optional sharing is disabled by default and requires explicit consent.

Public preview: workflow contract tests do not establish comparative coding quality, production readiness, or measured savings. Human approvals, CI, deployment, and live qualification remain separate.
